neighbours.label: devotional text spoken in the first-person plural (us / our / we, French nous, Spanish nos): fires on function words inside the collective prayer or confession; the same text in the third person, or secular 'we', is weaker
fire: Heavenly Father, have mercy on us, and wash away our guilt, for we have turned from your ways and our souls are weary.
Christ died for us while we were still sinners, and raised us up to walk with him in newness of life.
Seigneur, tu nous appelles à te suivre, et tu veux que nous restions dans ton amour et dans ta paix.
Señor, tú nos has creado para ti, y nuestro corazón está inquieto hasta que descansemos en ti y seamos lo que somos.
Let us give thanks to the Lord our God, who in turn has given us his Son, that we might be saved by grace.
Because of the great love with which he loved us, God made us his children and gave us a share in his kingdom.
Jésus nous a ouvert le chemin de la vie, et il nous invite à porter notre croix et à marcher vers le Père.
Our Saviour came to us in our weakness, bore our sorrows, and by his wounds we are healed and made whole.
quiet: Heavenly Father, have mercy on them, and wash away their guilt, for they have turned from your ways and their souls are weary.
Christ died for sinners while they were still far off, and raised them up to walk with him in newness of life.
Le Seigneur appelle ses disciples à le suivre, et il veut qu'ils restent dans son amour et dans sa paix.
El Señor creó al hombre para sí, y su corazón está inquieto hasta que descanse en él.
Let us thank the board of directors, who in turn has given us a new office, so that we might finish the project by June.
Because of the long drought, the farmers sold their cattle and moved their families to the city.
At our company we value our customers, and we invite you to try our new range of kitchen tools.
The priest read the gospel, blessed the bread, and sent the congregation out into the cold morning.

notes: Output direction of this pole suppresses our/we/us. Probes: devotional we 0.34-0.53, third-person devotional 0.07-0.21, secular 'we must' 0.26, corporate we 0.01.
